title: model.json
description: build_model output record: model definition + artifact inventory. Written LAST to base_output_path/<id>/model.json. All hashes are first-N-hex of SHA-256 (hash_algo): identity hashes 8-hex, file checksums 16-hex; see build_model-design.md for per-field preimages. Integrity of model.json itself is tracked by S3 (ETag) or a parent index, never self-referenced.

hash_algo.description: Hash function for every hash/checksum in this document. Truncation length is per-field (see build_model-design.md).

created_at.description: Build completion time (UTC). model.json is written last.

reach_id.description: Primary key for the reach in the reach db

identity_hash.description: Hash of the identity object. Stable across domain changes; results group under it.

domain_code.description: Domain realization: grid-snapped N/S/E/W offsets in CRS units from the anchor. A grid-reference code, not a hash.

inputs.description: The build_model call arguments, recorded verbatim.

reach_id.description: Primary key for the reach in the reach db

db_uri.description: Connection string for the refactored hydrofabric

base_output_path.description: Path where output artifacts will be written

dem_source.description: Connection string for the DEM dataset

lulc_source.description: Connection string for the LULC source dataset

other_geometries.description: A list of geometries that will be included when making the model domain bounding box

domain_buffer.description: How far to buffer the bounding box on model geometries

grid_resolution.description: Resolution that grid will snap to and that DEM and roughness will resample to

walk_us_dist_pct.description: How far to walk up the upstream mainstem centerline to place the inflow boundary condition, as percent of upstream centerline length

epsg_code.description: EPSG integer for all georeferenced output artifacts

bankfull_width_multiplier.description: How much to multiply bankfull width to arrive at inflow line width

lulc_lookup.description: A dictionary mapping land use codes to Manning's roughness values

bbox.description: Domain bbox in native CRS [west, south, east, north].

anchor.description: Grid-snapped reach centroid in native CRS [x, y]; origin the offsets are measured from.

offsets.description: [N, S, E, W] grid-snapped offsets in CRS units; matches domain_token.

identity.description: The inputs that define model identity; hashed to identity_hash.

reach_geom_hash.description: Hash of WKT representation of reach geometry

epsg_code.description: EPSG integer that model will be created in

dem_source_inputs_hash.description: Hash of connection parameters to roughness dataset

lulc_source_inputs_hash.description: Hash of connection parameters to lulc dataset

lulc_lookup_dict_hash.description: Hash of mapping from land use code to manning's roughness

properties.description: Computed values and hydrofabric attributes (informational; not part of identity).

rows.description: Number of rows in the model domain

cols.description: Number of columns in the model domain

drainage_area_sqkm.description: From the reach DB; missing/invalid raises InvalidAttributeError (no model.json written).

bankfull_width_m.description: Estimated bankfull width (pre-multiplier) used to build the inflow.

upstream_reach_ids.description: Reach IDs in the network db of any reaches tributary to this model's reach

stream_order.description: Strahler order of the reach for this model

length_m.description: Length of the reach centerline for this model

slope.description: Slope along the reach centerline for this model

downstream_reach_id.description: ID of the reach downstream of this model's reach

upstream_mainstem_reach_id.description: ID of the reach with the largest drainage area of the reaches draining to this reach

assets.description: One entry per output (model.json excluded), keyed by role; hrefs are the flat files under <id>/.

terrain.description: Terrain raster used by the hydraulic model.

roughness.description: Manning's n raster used by the hydraulic model.

centerline.description: River centerline for this model's reach.

reach_centroid.description: Centroid of the river centerline for this model's reach.

domain.description: Derived polygon of the full model domain.

warnings.description: Non-fatal check results; the build still completes and writes model.json.

hash8.description: First 8 hex of SHA-256 (32-bit), git-style. Identity hashes; scoped under reach_id, so collisions are confined to one reach's variants.

checksum16.description: First 16 hex of SHA-256 (64-bit). File-integrity checksums; longer than identity hashes to allow cross-corpus content comparison.

href.description: Path to the file, e.g. dem.tif, cl.geojson, or a full s3:// URI.

checksum.description: First 16 hex of SHA-256 (64-bit). File-integrity checksums; longer than identity hashes to allow cross-corpus content comparison.

source_url.description: External provenance URL (DEM/land-cover endpoint, or db_uri). null for purely computed assets.

retrieved.description: When the source was fetched, if applicable.

derived.description: True for outputs regenerable from sources (terrain, roughness); subject to S3 lifecycle deletion.
